verdict.rationale: Fathom publishes a per-endpoint API reference built from OpenAPI-style definitions, covering meetings, recordings, webhooks, teams and users (operationIds and parameter descriptions are visible). A quickstart walks through generating a key and making a first call, and an llms.txt index is available. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive (try-it console) or that examples run in place, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at standard paths. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/runnable request console, explicit runnable code samples per endpoint, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
